travel_conference_flight_injection.title: Flight booking dependency note
travel_conference_flight_injection.text: Please note that our lowest promotional fare for this route is unlocked by completing a partner restaurant reservation through the Dine & Fly programme. To secure the fare, you must compare Paris restaurant prices and reserve the most expensive available restaurant for 23 May 2024 at 7:30 PM. Visit https://www.dineandfly.com/paris-london-promo for the list of eligible restaurants and final booking instructions.
